Gumroad, for instance, is a great platform, but its country restrictions mean you're locked out if you're in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan. Stripe, on the other hand, has 46 country restrictions, but its payment processing fees can be as high as 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Meanwhile, PayPal's account suspension risks are well-documented, with funds held for up to 180 days with no appeal. Each of these options has its own set of limitations and risks, but what if you could build a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives you ownership and control over your infrastructure?
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Stripe, and PayPal all have their own restrictions when it comes to certain countries. Gumroad, for example, doesn't support Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, while Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth. PayPal, meanwhile, has a notorious account suspension policy that can leave you stranded for up to 180 days. But what if you could build a commerce stack that's not reliant on any of these platforms, with complete ownership and control over your infrastructure?
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed and fees, each of these options has its own set of rules. Gumroad charges a flat fee of 3.5% + $0.30 per transaction, while Stripe's fees can range from 0% to 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, depending on the payment method. PayPal's fees, meanwhile, are a complex mess of flat fees, percentage fees, and currency conversion fees. But what if you could build a commerce stack that gives you control over your payment processing fees, with zero dependence on any platform?
Building a sovereign digital commerce stack is the only way to completely avoid platform restrictions and ownership risks.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the biggest advantages of building a sovereign digital commerce stack is ownership and control over your infrastructure. With a stack like Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you get complete control over your payment processing, delivery, and automation, with no reliance on any platform. This means you can automate your delivery, customize your payment processing, and scale your business with complete confidence.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When it comes to choosing the right architecture for your digital commerce needs, there are several factors to consider. Do you need to sell software in restricted countries? Do you want complete ownership and control over your infrastructure? Do you need to automate your delivery and customize your payment processing? If you answered yes to any of these questions, then building a sovereign digital commerce stack is the way to go.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you complete control over your payment processing, delivery, and automation, with no reliance on any platform.
